items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Aaron Bell? [INTERVIEWEE] No, no, it wasn't him. He's been around. Good bass player. He still works around.

ctx.x: The fellow with the long hair who does all the work nowadays, one of your top bass players, he lives up here and his mother lives in Queens. I'll think of his name after a while. Good bass player, one of the best.

No, no, it wasn't him. He's been around. Good bass player. He still works around. Let me see. Bill Coleman was on trumpet. Bill Coleman was with us once. I'm trying to think, was he with... I don't know if Bill Coleman was with Kirby or Billy Kyle. Because Bill Coleman worked in one of the bands, and Wallace Jones worked in one of the bands. I forget which was which.
